Assalamualaikum — I'm Muhammed Meraj Khan, a Web & Application Developer based in Karachi, Pakistan, currently studying Intermediate (Pre-Engineering) at TCF College alongside building real products for the web.

My focus is simple: real-world applications people actually use. I've shipped a learning portal, e-commerce websites and an SMM panel — all live, all built end-to-end by me, from UI to deployment.

What sets my work apart is the finish: clean, premium, unique design with cinematic animations and interactive details — the opposite of a generic template. My goal is a remote developer role where I can keep doing exactly that, at a higher level, every day.
